errors: Amit Daryanani Q&A attributes the memory-cost answer ('memory cost inflation will rise further in September despite inventory offsets') to Kevan Parekh, CFO; Tim Cook answered the memory question.
Erik Woodring Q&A attributes the Services deceleration explanation (FX, mobile gaming, link-out ruling, theatrical compare) to Tim Cook, CEO; Kevan Parekh answered that part.
Samik Chatterjee Q&A attributes 'more than 100% of the adjusted 160 basis point sequential gross margin drop is caused by memory cost inflation' to Tim Cook, CEO; Kevan Parekh said this.
Lists 'Widow's Bay' as a new mention; the prior-quarter call already mentioned Widow's Bay.
summaries.comment: Solid numbers and guidance table with a usable what-changed section, but three Q&A answers are credited to the wrong executive and the read lines are generous.

errors: 'Tim Cook officially transitioned to Executive Chairman, with John Ternus assuming the role of Chief Executive Officer' and every label 'Tim Cook, Executive Chairman': the transcript calls Cook CEO on this call and Ternus the 'incoming CEO'; Cook says this is his final call, not that the transition has happened.
Tone shift says 'the executive leadership transition was completed'; it had not been completed per the transcript.
'up 80 basis points150' is garbled text.
Dropped topics list 'MacBook Neo and Education Market Share' and 'A19 and A19 Pro chips', yet both MacBook Neo (with education wins) and A19/A19 Pro are discussed on this call.
Michael Ng exchange rated 'answered directly' though Cook gave no adoption expectations and said 'I don't want to say that we have a complete plan' on compute costs.
Services guidance revision 'down from 16% YoY guided for Q3 FY26': the prior guide was growth similar to the March quarter after removing FX, not a stated 16% guide.
summaries.comment: Wrongly reports the CEO transition as already completed and mislabels Cook throughout, with blank Q&A questions and a flawed dropped-topics list.
Tight and accurate, with the ex-refund margin walk, a fair unanswered list and a specific tone-shift contrast; it skips the Amit and Ng exchanges in Q&A but covers them elsewhere.

errors: Lists 'iPhone Air' as a new mention; the prior-quarter call already discussed iPhone Air.
summaries.comment: The most complete and carefully attributed Q&A, with precise read lines, but it runs well past the length target and repeats points across sections.

errors: Amit Daryanani Q&A attributes the memory-cost offsets answer to Kevan Parekh; Tim Cook gave it.
Samik Chatterjee answer says 'Mac gets Siri AI immediately'; Cook said it 'is offered or will be offered for the Mac' in the EU, with no 'immediately'.
Key takeaway cites 'advanced node and memory supply constraints'; Cook said the constraint is advanced nodes, with memory a cost issue.
New mentions list MacBook Neo, iPhone Air, iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, MacBook Pro, AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2; all were mentioned on the prior call.
Michael Ng exchange rated 'answered directly' though no adoption figures or complete compute-cost plan were given.
'up 16% year-from-a-year ago' is garbled.
summaries.comment: Covers the basics, but its new-mentions list is mostly wrong, guidance is unattributed and the Q&A reads are too generous.

errors: Samik Chatterjee answer attributed to Tim Cook, CEO ('more than 100% explained by the memory cost change'); Kevan Parekh said this.

Ben Reitzes unanswered entry pairs the silicon-provider question with 'Explicitly declined to provide color or guidance beyond the September quarter'; the refusal on future periods answered the December question, while Cook answered the silicon question by saying it is not a supplier issue and citing Arizona.
Q&A answers are written as first-person quotes that are not verbatim transcript text.
summaries.comment: Thin and generic, with few numbers beyond the headline figures, a misattributed margin answer and little real what-changed insight.

errors: Lists 'A19 and A19 Pro chips' as a new mention; the prior-quarter call already mentioned A19 and A19 Pro.
'Siri AI arrives this fall' is not stated; Cook's 'this fall' referred to the child-safety features and OS updates.
summaries.comment: The best balance of density and accuracy: correct attributions, precise margin and FX walks, a fair unanswered list and a concrete tone shift.

errors: Dropped topics list 'CEO leadership transition' and 'iPhone 17 family momentum'; both are discussed on this call (Cook's final call; iPhone 17 family drove iPhone growth).
New mentions list iPhone Air, iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17e; all appear on the prior call.
Amit Daryanani answer credits Kevan Parekh with the June-quarter constraint detail, which Tim Cook gave.
Amit memory answer says memory costs were 'expected to rise significantly again in June'; Cook said that is what happened in June.
Every Q&A read is 'direct', including Aaron Rakers' new-markets question, which named no specific markets.
summaries.comment: Barely a summary: one-line overview, bare-label takeaways and risks, no tone shift, unexplained 'partial' dodges and a wrong what-changed list.
